'''Lemon''' and [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] were two of the ingredients used to make [[lemon cake]]. One such [[Cake/Legends|cake]] was discovered by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] within a [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] case that he had not expected would contain it.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref> [[Roonan lemon]]s were a type of lemon.<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
